name: context-guard
description: Context-budget guard: a Stop hook enforces a per-model checkpoint protocol, writing a mechanical checkpoint stub at the WARN threshold and forcing checkpoint-then-clear at the hard cap. On Codex the model writes the stub directly (no subagent-spawn tool is assumed); on Claude Code the WARN reflection delegates to a budgeted memory-writer subagent, and a SubagentStop tracker surfaces true session spend.

interface.shortDescription: Enforce a per-model context checkpoint before the window fills
interface.longDescription: A Stop hook measures the session's current context size against per-model WARN/hard thresholds. At WARN it writes a mechanical checkpoint stub (git branch, last commit, modified files, token count) and blocks the stop once as a reflection pause so the model persists a semantic summary before continuing. At the hard cap it forces the checkpoint-then-clear procedure.
